title: 📢 CLASS SUSPENSION ANNOUNCEMENT | AUGUST 20 & 21
message:
Due to inclement weather, there will be NO FACE-TO-FACE CLASSES for all levels tomorrow, August 20, 2026. Classes will shift to ONLINE CLASSES. More details will be provided through your respective class group chats.

Please also be reminded that there will be NO CLASSES on August 21, 2026 in celebration of Ninoy Aquino Day.
